---
name: story-quality
description: "Assess story clarity and quality independently."
---
# Procedure

Use docs/QUALITY_RUBRIC.md. For each dimension assign 0-4 and evidence/rationale; the controller computes scores. Maintain blocking_questions. Verify acceptance tests are observable, not paraphrases of requirements. Report all gaps even if the average exceeds 85. Re-score when requirements change.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
